description: Rejection fixture reproducing the lane C1 failure mode: content the source does not supply, which runPleadingQa passes because QA reads relief vocabulary, template grade, the footer and seal markers rather than truth.
statedFailureReason: The fixture asserts that the court has already found the RCW 9.94A.640(2) tests satisfied when that finding is discretionary and belongs to the court, reports a hearing and a granted motion when the packet records that nothing in the Motion asserts the court has exercised or will exercise that discretion, asserts that the prosecuting attorney does not object, states a filing fee the source expressly does not establish and names it in words as an established amount, asserts completed service when RCW 9.95.240 prescribes no service at all, and populates the protected docket number, OTN and judge fields.

expectedSignals.violation: Asserts that the court has already found the RCW 9.94A.640(2) tests met and that the record shall be cleared. The packet records that relief is discretionary on both limbs and that nothing in the Motion asserts the court has exercised or will exercise that discretion.
expectedSignals.rule: Relief is discretionary on both limbs. The court may permit withdrawal of the plea or set aside the verdict in its discretion, and may in its discretion clear the record. Nothing in this Motion asserts that the court has exercised or will exercise that discretion.

expectedSignals.violation: Reports that a hearing was held and that the motion was granted, asserting the very exercise of discretion the packet says the Motion never asserts.
expectedSignals.rule: Relief is discretionary on both limbs. The court may permit withdrawal of the plea or set aside the verdict in its discretion, and may in its discretion clear the record. Nothing in this Motion asserts that the court has exercised or will exercise that discretion.

expectedSignals.violation: States that the prosecuting attorney does not object and agrees the record should be vacated. The prosecutor's position is not the movant's to supply.
expectedSignals.rule: Relief is discretionary on both limbs. The court may permit withdrawal of the plea or set aside the verdict in its discretion, and may in its discretion clear the record. Nothing in this Motion asserts that the court has exercised or will exercise that discretion.

expectedSignals.violation: States a dollar amount for the filing fee and asserts it was paid on a date. No committed Washington evidence establishes a fee for a vacation petition in district, municipal or superior court.
expectedSignals.rule: Filing fee: the source does not establish a filing fee for a vacation petition in district, municipal or superior court. No amount may be stated to a participant; confirm with the clerk.

expectedSignals.violation: Names the fee in words as an established amount ('filing fee of 240 dollars') when the source establishes none.
expectedSignals.rule: Filing fee: the source does not establish a filing fee for a vacation petition in district, municipal or superior court. No amount may be stated to a participant; confirm with the clerk.

expectedSignals.violation: Asserts that the Motion was duly served on the prosecuting attorney on a stated date and that service was completed. RCW 9.95.240 as read at source prescribes no service and no certificate of service, and none is drafted.
expectedSignals.rule: Service requirements are not established. RCW 9.95.240 as read at source prescribes no service on the prosecuting attorney and no certificate of service, and no pattern form supplies one. No certificate of service is drafted; confirm local rules with the clerk before filing.

expectedSignals.violation: Populates caseData.docketNumber, caseData.otn and caseData.judgeName, which the protected-field policy requires to stay blank in every fixture.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

expectedSignals.violation: The populated docket number reaches the caption in place of the blank-docket placeholder.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

expectedSignals.violation: The populated OTN reaches the rendered text.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

expectedSignals.violation: The populated judge name reaches the rendered text.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Vacation of the record of a pre-1984 conviction under RCW 9.95.240(2)(a)
additionalFacts: The Court finds that Defendant has met the equivalent of the RCW 9.94A.640(2) tests and that the record shall be cleared.
The prosecuting attorney does not object to this Motion and agrees that the record should be vacated.
A hearing was held on 03/20/2026 and the motion was granted.
Defendant paid the filing fee of 240 dollars ($240) to the clerk of the superior court on 02/14/2026.
A copy of this Motion was duly served on the prosecuting attorney on 03/01/2026, and service was completed that day.
